remarks: Completely renovated from top to bottom, this gorgeous 1 bedroom will WOW you! Sparkling, new kitchen with grey oak cabinets, granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances (gas range/oven and refrigerator not shown in photo) and large pantry flows right into the open concept, sun-soaked living room. Bright bedroom with large closet and space for your king-size bed. Stylish full bathroom that you will swoon over, hardwood floors thru-out and large balcony complete the full package! Private washer/dryer plus additional storage closet in the basement. 2 off-street parking spaces plus plenty of street parking. 1 mile to the train station, Greenwich Avenue & I-95. Your search for your perfect place to call home will stop right here!
